# RuForge

> RuForge is a free open-source desktop media library and yt-dlp frontend for Windows. Built with Tauri v2 and Rust, it downloads YouTube videos, music, and playlists, stores them in a local library, and includes a full media player with chapter navigation, SponsorBlock integration, music Now Playing, a mini player, and a Games mode with guides, videos and an in-game overlay for the games you play. Apache-2.0 licensed. No ads. No telemetry. No premium tier.

RuForge uses yt-dlp as the download engine and FFmpeg for media processing; both download on first launch, checked against SHA-256 sums. It ships as a signed Windows installer with an auto-updater. Linux is supported for local development; macOS is not yet supported as a release target.

## Feature pages

- [Downloader](https://ruforge.app/features/downloader): Persistent download queue, batch carousel hero, playlists, Deno auto-install, audio-only mode
- [Media library](https://ruforge.app/features/media-library): Local library with watch progress, Continue watching, and In progress and Watched tabs
- [Music mode](https://ruforge.app/features/music): Offline music player with lyrics, albums, artists, and playlists
- [Video player](https://ruforge.app/features/player): Chapter previews, SponsorBlock skipping, and saved comments
- [Mini player](https://ruforge.app/features/mini-player): Small always-on-top window with four sizes

- [Compare](https://ruforge.app/compare): RuForge next to other YouTube downloaders

- [RuForge vs 4K Video Downloader](https://ruforge.app/compare/4k-video-downloader): Free and open source vs a paid app with a limited free plan
